root_cause.text: The fw_classify() function's old-method code path dereferences tcf_block_q()->handle without checking if block->q is NULL, which occurs in shared blocks where block->q is intentionally left NULL, causing a NULL pointer dereference when classifying packets with nonzero skb marks.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a validation check in fw_change() to reject the old-method configuration (no TCA_OPTIONS) when used on shared blocks by calling tcf_block_shared(tp->chain->block). The CVE description explicitly states "Shared blocks leave block->q NULL" and the old-method path in fw_classify() "calls tcf_block_q() and dereferences q->handle," which would fail when block->q is NULL. The fix prevents this incompatible configuration from being created in the first place, rather than handling the NULL pointer at runtime.

commit d8aecb10115497f6cdf841df8c88ebb3ba25fa28
Author: WANG Cong <xiyou.wangcong@gmail.com>

    net: revert "net_sched: move tp->root allocation into fw_init()"
    
    fw filter uses tp->root==NULL to check if it is the old method,
    so it doesn't need allocation at all in this case. This patch
    reverts the offending commit and adds some comments for old
    method to make it obvious.
    
    Fixes: 33f8b9ecdb15 ("net_sched: move tp->root allocati
bic_trace_step.reason: This commit FIXES the vulnerability rather than introducing it. The vulnerability root cause was that fw_classify() dereferenced tcf_block_q()->handle (via tp->q->handle) without checking if block->q is NULL in shared blocks. In the old method code path (lines 85-90 in the diff), the code accesses 'tp->q->handle' directly. However, this commit removes the forced allocation of fw_head in fw_init() and instead allocates it lazily in fw_change() only when needed (lines 299-310). This change allows tp->root to remain NULL for old-method filters, which is the correct behavior. The key fix is that by not allocating fw_head unconditionally, the code properly distinguishes between old-method (tp->root==NULL) and new-method filters. The old-method path at line 85-90 still accesses tp->q->handle, but this is only reached when using the old method where tp->q is guaranteed to be valid. The commit's comment 'Old method: classify the packet using its skb mark' and the fw_init() comment 'We don't allocate fw_head here, because in the old method we don't need it at all' confirm this is a fix that restores proper NULL checking semantics by allowing tp->root to be NULL for old-method filters.
